description: Code, frozen derived results, protocols and figures for a secondary public-data comparison of eosinophilic colitis and ulcerative colitis, with a post hoc gastric comparison and matched-random-gene-set evaluation. The primary global convergence result was negative. The internal plan was not publicly preregistered. Source expression matrices and manuscript drafts are not included. Software: MIT. Original derived results, figures and documentation: CC BY 4.0; third-party materials retain original terms. See README for tested reproducibility scope.
